Blunt Weapon MasteryPage · 2nd Job

COT1: Blunt Weapon Mastery gave Attack Power +20 plus a 25% chance to stun for 3 sec. COT2 reworked the secondary bonus into a 20% chance to ignore the enemy's Weapon Defense; the attack bonus and the stun are removed. The old 25% and the new 20% describe different effects, so they are not shown as a before and after. Mastery level 10 is unchanged.

Poison BreathF/P Wizard · 2nd Job

COT1: the droplet dealt damage itself, so at max level the skill listed Basic Attack 40 for the droplet plus 35 for its explosion. COT2: the droplet only triggers, and the damage, Mastery, poison chance and poison damage all sit on the explosion, which hits up to 4 enemies. Max level now shows a single Basic Attack 80, with poison at 40 over 5 sec where COT1 had 30 over 8 sec.

Skill changes FAQ

How many named MapleStory Classic skills changed from COT1 to COT2?

37 named, player-facing skills have verified COT1 to COT2 change records. 1 additional changed record is an unnamed internal attack node and is not presented as a separate skill.

What values does this skill comparison use?

Numeric rows compare the same field in the COT1 and COT2 in-game data snapshots at each skill's maximum level.

Where can I see all MapleStory Classic third-job skills?

The Skills database lists all 70 third-job skills across 10 job books. This comparison narrows that catalog to the 3 third-job entries with COT1 to COT2 move records: Power Guard in Crusader and White Knight, and Hyper Body in Dragon Knight.

Why is Poison Breath not listed as a COT2 skill change?

Poison Breath is held out because its COT2 numeric level table conflicts with the text shown to players. The site keeps its COT1 record until the COT2 behavior can be verified in game.
